_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Södertälje Syd (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).

Draft withheld (not in data/stations): OSM has almost no walking network here (2 nodes, 1 edge) and no entrance: the platforms cannot reach an exit. Needs the operator's station plan or a walk for an entrance before it can ship.

Still withheld after the research pass: OSM maps no footways between the platforms and the street here (2 nodes after the draft); the research's 3 entrances (OSM positions) have nothing to attach to. Needs the walkways from a plan or a walk.
